5100.meaning1: able to stand scrutiny; fit for examination
5100.meaning2: which can stand scrutiny; who is fit to be questioned
5100.commentary: (MNa) no anuyogakkhamo, no vimajjanakkhamo'ti anuyogaṃ vā vīmaṃsaṃ vā na khamati, thuse koṭṭetvā taṇḍulapariyesanaṃ viya kadaliyaṃ sāragavesanaṃ viya ca rittako tucchako'va hoti.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhante, bālānaṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ vādo raṅgakkhamo hi kho bālānaṃ no paṇḍitānaṃ, no anuyogakkhamo, no vimajjanakkhamo.

5102.meaning1: disgust with scrutiny; abhorrence of examination

examples.text: yo mam'assa vighāto, so mam'assa antarāyo'ti. iti so anuyogabhayā anuyogaparijegucchā n'ev'idaṃ kusalan'ti byākaroti, na pan'idaṃ akusalan'ti byākaroti, tattha tattha pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno vācāvikkhepaṃ āpajjati amarāvikkhepaṃ

5103.meaning1: fear of interrogation; fear of scrutiny
5103.meaning2: fear of interrogation; fearing scrutiny; afraid of examination

examples.text: yo mam'assa vighāto, so mam'assa antarāyo'ti. iti so anuyogabhayā anuyogaparijegucchā n'ev'idaṃ kusalan'ti byākaroti, na pan'idaṃ akusalan'ti byākaroti, tattha tattha pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno vācāvikkhepaṃ āpajjati amarāvikkhepaṃ
atha kho te bhikkhū, bhagavā anekapariyāyena asubhakathaṃ katheti, asubhāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatī'ti anek'ākāravokāraṃ asubhabhāvana-anuyogam'anuyuttā viharanti.
acelako ce'pi, kassapa, hoti, mutt'ācāro, hatth'āpalekhano… iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikam'pi pariyāya-bhatta-bhojana-anuyogam'anuyutto viharati.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappam'anvāya padhānam'anvāya anuyogam'anvāya appamādam'anvāya sammāmanasikāram'anvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati, yathāsamāhite citte (anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.

5108.meaning2: answers the question (satisfactorily), passes an examination

5109.meaning2: who is practising or engaged in
5109.construction:
anu + √yuj > yoj > yog + a + *ī
anuyoga + ī

examples.text: ayoge yuñjam'attānaṃ, yogasmiñ'ca ayojayaṃ, atthaṃ hitvā piyaggāhī, pihet'atta-anuyoginaṃ.

5110.meaning1: (of an army) not deployed; not on active duty; not on the march; (comm) not camped or on the march
5110.commentary: (VINa) anuyyuttā nāma rājā uyyānaṃ vā nadiṃ vā gacchati, evaṃ anuyyuttā hoti. (VVt) anuyyutte'pī'ti saṅgāmaṃ vinā aññena kāraṇena nikkhante. yath'āha anuyyuttā nāma rājā uyyānaṃ vā nadiṃ vā gacchati, evaṃ anuyyuttā hotī'ti.

examples.text: anuyyutte uyyuttasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anuyyutte vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anuyyutte anuyyuttasaññī, anāpatti.
anuyyutte uyyuttasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anuyyutte vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anuyyutte anuyyuttasaññī, anāpatti.
amhāka [chanda-anurakkhaṇ'atthaṃ niggahītalopo]

5114.meaning1: making effort to protect; striving to preserve

examples.text: katamañ'c'āvuso, anurakkhaṇāpadhānaṃ? idh'āvuso, bhikkhu uppannaṃ bhadrakaṃ samādhinimittaṃ anurakkhati, aṭṭhikasaññaṃ, puḷuvakasaññaṃ, vinīlakasaññaṃ, vicchiddakasaññaṃ, uddhumātakasaññaṃ.

5115.meaning1: making effort to guard (the theme for meditative composure)

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uppannaṃ bhaddakaṃ samādhinimittaṃ anurakkhati aṭṭhikasaññaṃ puḷavakasaññaṃ vinīlakasaññaṃ vicchiddakasaññaṃ uddhumātakasaññaṃ. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, anurakkhaṇāppadhānaṃ. imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri padhānānī'ti.

5116.synonym: anurakkhamāna, ārakkhanta, gopayanta, parittāyanta, pālayanta, rakkhanta, rakkhamāna, sārakkhanta

examples.text: saccam'anurakkhatā, bhāradvāja, viññunā purisena n'ālam'ettha ek'aṃsena niṭṭhaṃ gantuṃ, idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti.
idha, visākhe, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakamm'anto hoti, saṅgahitaparijano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
mātā yathā niyaṃ puttaṃ, āyusā ekaputtam'anurakkhe, evam'pi sabbabhūtesu, mānasaṃ bhāvaye aparimāṇaṃ.

5119.meaning1: making effort to protect; striving to preserve

examples.text: cattāri padhānāni. saṃvarapadhānaṃ pahānapadhānaṃ bhāvanāpadhānaṃ anurakkhanāppadhānaṃ. katamañ'c'āvuso, saṃvarapadhānaṃ?

5120.synonym: anurakkhanta, ārakkhanta, gopayanta, pālayanta, rakkhanta, rakkhamāna, sārakkhanta
5120.commentary: (VVa) mātāva puttaṃ anurakkhamānā'ti yathā mātā puttaṃ, evaṃ mayhaṃ sāmikaṃ, sabbe'pi vā satte hitesitāya ahitāpanayanakāmatāya ca anuddayamānā.

examples.text: te maṃ pitugharaṃ paṭinayiṃsu, vimanā dukhena adhibhūtā, puttam'anurakkhamānā, jit'āmhase rūpiniṃ lakkhiṃ.
kikī'va aṇḍaṃ, camarī'va vāladhiṃ, piyaṃ'va puttaṃ, nayanaṃ'va ekakaṃ, tath'eva sīlaṃ, anurakkhamānā.

ehi tvaṃ, gāmaṇi, yena samaṇo gotamo ten'upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ vadehi, nanu, bhante, bhagavā anekapariyāyena kulānaṃ anuddayaṃ vaṇṇeti, anurakkhaṃ vaṇṇeti, anukampaṃ vaṇṇetī'ti?

5124.meaning1: should be looked after; should be protected (by)

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhuno saddhāya akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, hiriyā akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, ottappena akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, vīriyena akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, paññāya akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, anurakkhitabbo tāva me so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu hoti.

5125.commentary: (THa) tathā anurakkhituṃ pāletuṃ sukaraṃ, tathā na sukaraṃ, tathā sampādetuṃ na sakkā'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ nānāppayātamhi, na dāni sukaraṃ tathā. aphusitaṃ vā phusituṃ, phusitaṃ vā-anurakkhituṃ.

5127.meaning1: looking after; taking care of; guarding; protecting

examples.text: tayā sudantena avaṭṭhitena hi, hayena yogg'ācariyo'va ujjunā, pahomi maggaṃ paṭipajjituṃ sivaṃ, citta-anurakkhīhi sadā nisevitaṃ.
mā ca vāt'ātape cārittaṃ anuyuñji, mā te vāt'ātape cārittaṃ anuyuttassa rajosūkaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ anuddhaṃsesi. vaṇa-anurakkhī ca, ambho purisa, vihareyyāsi vaṇasāropī'ti.

5136.commentary: (MNa) anuraho man'ti purimasadisam'eva bhikkhuṃ gahetvā vihārapaccante sen'āsanaṃ pavesetvā dvāraṃ thaketvā codente icchati.

examples.text: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, āvuso, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekaccassa bhikkhuno evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya, āpattiñ'ca vata āpanno assaṃ, anuraho maṃ bhikkhū codeyyuṃ, no saṅghamajjhe'ti.

5137.meaningLit: son of Rādha; (or) born under the constellation of Anurādha

examples.text: yo so, āvuso anurādha, tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto, taṃ tathāgato imesu catūsu ṭhānesu paññāpayamāno paññāpeti, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti vā, na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti vā, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti vā, n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti vā'ti?

so uppannaṃ lābhaṃ anurujjhati, alābhe paṭivirujjhati, uppannaṃ yasaṃ anurujjhati, ayase paṭivirujjhati, uppannaṃ pasaṃsaṃ anurujjhati, nindāya paṭivirujjhati, uppannaṃ sukhaṃ anurujjhati, dukkhe paṭivirujjhati.

5141.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in the divine eye; cousin of the Buddha
5141.commentary: (AN 1.192) etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dibbacakkhukānaṃ yadidaṃ anuruddho.
5141.notes: Theragāthā verses 892-919 (TH16.9, TH256) are attributed to him.

examples.text: āyasmatā ca mahācundena āyasmatā ca anuruddhena āyasmatā ca revatena āyasmatā ca ānandena, aññehi ca abhiññātehi abhiññātehi therehi sāvakehi saddhiṃ.
yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha ime aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi, tato tvaṃ anuruddha yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhissasi…
sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, ananuruddh'āppaṭiviruddhass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā, na sā niṭṭhā anuruddhappaṭiviruddhassā'ti.

5145.meaning1: who favours and opposes; who accepts and rejects

examples.text: sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, ananuruddh'āppaṭiviruddhass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā, na sā niṭṭhā anuruddhappaṭiviruddhassā'ti.

5151.synonym: atthika, anucchavi, anucchavika, anuloma, anulomika, upiya, paṭirūpa, patirūpa, patirūpī, yuttaka, yuttarūpa, sāmīcika, sāruppa

examples.text: yattakā bhikkhū tassa uposathakammassa pattayuttā anurūpā, sabb'antimena paricchedena cattāro bhikkhū pakatattā, saṅghena anukkhitā, te ca kho hatthapāsaṃ avijahitvā ekasīmayaṃ ṭhitā.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: idha ākhyāte aniddiṭṭhesu sādhanesu kvaci dhātu vibhatti paccayānaṃ dīgha viparīt'ādesa lop'āgama'icc'etāni kāriyāni jinavacana-anurūpāni kātabbāni.

5153.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of anurūpa

examples.text: tassa-anurodhā atha vā virodhā, vidhūpitā atthagatā na santi, padañ'ca ñatvā virajaṃ asokaṃ, sammā pajānāti bhavassa pāragū'ti.

5157.meaning1: liking and disliking; favouring and opposing; accepting and rejecting; (comm) craving and aversion
5157.meaning2: compliance, and opposition; liking and dislike

examples.text: so evaṃ anurodhavirodhaṃ samāpanno yaṃ kiñci vedanaṃ vedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham'asukhaṃ vā, so taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.

5158.meaning1: dispelled liking and disliking; given up favouring and opposing; removed accepting and rejecting

examples.text: so evaṃ anurodhavirodhavippahīno yaṃ kiñci vedanaṃ vedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham'asukhaṃ vā, so taṃ vedanaṃ n'ābhinandati n'ābhivadati n'ājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.

5165.commentary: (VINa) sīs'ānulokikā'ti paṭhamaṃ pavisantīnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ sīsaṃ anulokentī pavisati, anāpatti.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto taramānarūpo nisīdanaṃ ādāya āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi sīsa-anulokī.

5169.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of anuloma (+dat)
5169.commentary: (SNa) anulomaṃ abhavissa ñāṇassa uppādāya sabbe dhammā anattā'ti yaṃ etaṃ sabbe dhammā anattā'ti vipassanāñāṇaṃ uppajjati, api nu me tassa anulomaṃ abhavissā'ti attho.

examples.text: ahañ'c'ānanda, vacchagottassa paribbājakassa atth'attā'ti puṭṭho samāno atth'attā'ti byākareyyaṃ, api nu me taṃ, ānanda, anulomaṃ abhavissa ñāṇassa uppādāya, sabbe dhammā anattā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

5176.commentary: (MNa) anulomikānī'ti paṭipattianulomāni kammaṭṭhānasappāyāni, yattha vasantena sakkā honti maggaphalāni pāpuṇituṃ. (ANa) sāmaññass'ānulomikā'ti samaṇadhammassa anulomā.

examples.text: app'eva nāmime āyasmanto anulomikāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevamānā kalyāṇamitte bhajamānā indriyāni samannānayamānā, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ, brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyun'ti!
ye c'assa dhammā akkhātā, sāmaññassa-anulomikā, adhiggahitā tuṭṭhassa, appamattassa sikkhato'ti.

anu + loma + e + ti
anuloma + e + ti

examples.text: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū suggahitehi sutt'antehi (na) byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca anulomenti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.

anuloma + e + ti

5182.commentary: (VINa) anullapan'ādhippāyassā'ti kohaññe icch'ācāre aṭhatvā anullapan'ādhippāyassa sabrahmacārīnaṃ santike aññaṃ byākarontassa anāpatti.

examples.text: anāpatti adhimānena, anullapan'ādhippāyassa, ummattakassa, khittacittassa, vedan'āṭṭassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

5185.meaning1: recited again; rehearsed again; repeated over

examples.text: pañcahi yā saṅgītā, anusaṅgītā ca pacchā'pi, sīhaḷadīpaṃ pana ābhatātha, vasinā mahāmahindena.

anu + saṃ + √ghaṭ > ghāt + *a + aṃ
anusaṅghāta + aṃ

5190.meaning1: walking along the side (of); strolling around

examples.text: atha te, jarasakko amhe matte katvā mahāsamuddapiṭṭhe khipitvā amhākaṃ devanagaraṃ gaṇhi, te mayaṃ tena saddhiṃ yujjhitvā amhākaṃ devanagaram'eva gaṇhissāmā'ti kipillikā viya thambhaṃ sineruṃ anusañcaramānā uṭṭhahiṃsu.

5193.meaning1: walking along the side (of); wandering around

5194.meaning1: to go around; to visit; to inspect

examples.text: tasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye rañño na phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā niyyātuṃ vā paccantime vā janapade anusaññātuṃ.

5195.meaning2: goes through, travels about; inspects, supervises; goes along with, escorts

5196.commentary: (MNa) anusaññāyamāno'ti anusañjāyamāno, kat'ākataṃ jananto'ti attho. anuvicaramāno vā.

examples.text: atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamah'āmatto rājagahe kamm'ante anusaññāyamāno yena gopakamoggallānassa brāhmaṇassa kamm'anto, yen'āyasmā ānando ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi.
